name: Face Picker (free Blender add-on for 2D face animation, no rig)
summary: Free Blender add-on by SouthernShotty that turns numbered PNG sequences into a clickable library of facial expressions you browse and keyframe in the 3D Viewport. Simple mode swaps whole faces; Advanced mode controls eyes and mouth separately. Works for any image-sequence swap (screens, signs). Free tier includes the full add-on, a demo character and 25 starter face textures; a paid bundle adds 300+ faces and vector sources.

access.license: GPL (add-on code); Superhive Royalty Free (textures, models, vectors)
access.price: $0 add-on + sample assets; add-on + 300-face bundle $15 ($9.75 on sale)
access.notes: Assets: personal and commercial use OK, no resale/redistribution, not in logos. $0 checkout via the Superhive cart (account need not verified). Listed for Blender 5.3.

procedure: Pick the $0 option (add-on + free sample model and face textures) and add it to cart
Complete the $0 checkout and download the zip
In Blender 5.3: Edit > Preferences > Add-ons > Install from Disk, then open Face Picker in the 3D Viewport sidebar

stats.count: add-on + demo character + 25 face textures (free tier)

verdict.why: Useful free tool from a well-known Blender educator: stylized 2D face animation without rigging, keyed from thumbnails. Free tier is the full add-on (GPL) with starter faces. The big face library is paid, and it targets Blender 5.3.

image.alt: Face Picker banner: stylized cap-wearing character beside a grid of clickable 2D face expressions (Normal, Sad, Happy, Angry...)
